This targeted final combine may reduce CTA-local work versus a general 32-lane reduction, but the measured candidates suggest that any local change may be masked by complete-run costs. The launch geometry, one-value-per-lane loading, stage schedule, scratch selection, and final copy stay fixed so the controller can test the local change independently of topology.
